mention-input--variant-in-a-text-area.why: markup only: plain text in a textarea; typing @ opens a named EntityPicker (mode textarea)

mention-input--variant-in-rich-text.why: markup only: rich text in the editor engine, which keeps each mention as one atomic item (mode rich)

metadata-editor--variant-inline.why: markup only: each field is an InlineEdit that saves on its own (variant inline)

metadata-editor--variant-form.why: markup only: the fields are in one validated form that keeps drafts when a save fails (variant form)

metadata-editor--variant-bulk.why: markup only: applies only the fields explicitly selected and never overwrites untouched ones (variant bulk)

media-player--variant-video.why: markup only: native video playback (kind video, the default)

media-player--variant-audio.why: markup only: native audio playback (kind audio)

media-player--variant-captions.why: markup only: adds WebVTT caption or subtitle tracks to the player (tracks)

media-player--variant-transcript.why: markup only: adds a seekable transcript beside the player (transcript, showTranscript)

media-player--variant-playback-rate.why: markup only: offers playback speeds from rates, 0.5 to 2 by default

media-player--variant-picture-in-picture.why: markup only: offers the browser's picture in picture (pictureInPicture, default true)
